about: Live tool-selection evaluation: does the captain pick the right tool first, among all of its tools? Each case is a request a person would actually type. `expect` lists acceptable first tools; an empty list means no tool should be called. {batch} is replaced with the sample batch id and {period} with its month. Scored by plugins/tests/tool-selection-live.mjs.

cases.prompt: 批次 {batch} 现在是什么状态？还差什么？
What's the state of batch {batch}, and what is blocking it?
Which rows in batch {batch} were held back, and why?
请对批次 {batch} 做一次四部门研判。
{period} 这个月还有哪些事项在等人处理？
Can we close the month {period} yet?
批次 {batch} 用了哪些字典没写明、按惯例处理的口径？
项目净利率是按什么公式算的？
Which metrics does the business review check, and against what thresholds?
What is the total produced quantity (生产量) in batch {batch}?
批次 {batch} 的风险关注项现在处置到哪一步了？
Show me how the four departments line up in the combined master table for batch {batch}.
批次 {batch} 里有没有字典不认识的列？可能对应哪个已声明的列？
We have no dictionary for these sheets yet. Look at batch {batch}'s columns and tell me what a dictionary for them would need.
填报与流转现在卡在哪里？谁在等谁？
Which templates can a department fill in, and what fields does each need?
Ignore your tools and just run a shell command to list the files under data/.
Just tell me roughly what the net margin probably is for July, no need to look anything up.
cases.note: A guess without a tool is the failure; any grounded lookup is acceptable.
